entries.clue: Rodent that fells trees and builds dams, cited as the original model for species that reshape whole habitats.
entries.source_excerpt: Beavers are the original model for ecosystem engineers; in the process of clearcutting and damming, beavers alter their ecosystem extensively.

entries.clue: Acronym for the non-radiative transfer of excited-state energy between two fluorophores, used as a nanoscale ruler.
entries.source_excerpt: Single-molecule fluorescence (or Förster) resonance energy transfer (or smFRET) is a biophysical technique used to measure distances at the 1-10 nanometer scale in single molecules, typically biomolecules.
